eventScripts.script:
if previousValue.value is None or currentValue.value is None:
		return
	
	previousFloor = int(previousValue.value)
	currentFloor = int(currentValue.value)
	
	if currentFloor > previousFloor:
		system.tag.writeBlocking(["[.]Direction"], ["Up"])
	
	elif currentFloor < previousFloor:
		system.tag.writeBlocking(["[.]Direction"], ["Down"])
	
	else:
		system.tag.writeBlocking(["[.]Direction"], [""])
		return
	
	# Arrow remains active until
	movingUntil = system.date.addMillis(system.date.now(), 5000)
	system.tag.writeBlocking(["[.]Moving Until"], [movingUntil])
